extensions.scope: Discriminated object: {kind: product, id: affiliate_agent|lottery} or {kind: platform, id: lottorito}
extensions.sourceeventid: UUID string; identity is composite with tenant and scope
extensions.traceparent: W3C Trace Context version 00; trace and parent-span identifiers are validated

event_envelope.trace_context: W3C Trace Context traceparent; trace_id is 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters
event_envelope.time_format: RFC3339 date-time; leap-second lexical form is accepted
event_envelope.validation_profile: CloudEvents 1.0 core attributes plus Lottorito-required extensions; extension attributes remain permitted

legacy_mappings.p02.product_id: Canonical product values are affiliate_agent|lottery only in the disposable schema; shared is rejected for new writes. Existing shared rows require explicit inventory/quarantine and authoritative owner mapping; no automatic alias. P-02 tenant-only financial keys remain a separate open gap.
legacy_mappings.p03d.provider_event_inbox: tenant_id + product_id + provider_id + provider_event_id; source_event_id is persisted in the same product scope
legacy_mappings.p05b.p05_inbox: tenant_id + product_id + consumer_name + source_event_id; unique economic effect is also product-qualified; RLS enforces tenant and product.
legacy_mappings.p05b.p05_replay_cursor: tenant_id + product_id + consumer_name + aggregate_id; cursor row lock serializes replay independently per product.
legacy_mappings.p06.correlation_map: tenant_id + scope_kind + scope_id + source_event_id composite; trace_id is persisted; P-09I validates the source event envelope before correlation
legacy_mappings.p06.product_domain: affiliate_agent|lottery|platform; platform must map to platform scope, never to a product id
legacy_mappings.p07b.event_contracts: source_product and allowed_consumers map to product scope; dispatch enforces sourceeventid, schemaversion and traceparent through the shared P-09 validator
legacy_mappings.p08.artifact: P-09I binds the canonical product scope object and canonical product registry into release metadata and detached provenance
legacy_mappings.p02.financial_identity: P-09K: all P-02 disposable financial PK/UNIQUE/FK constraints, effect conflict arbiters, request/effect joins and outbox polling index include tenant_id + product_id. Same tenant/account/effect/event/idempotency identifiers are integration-tested independently in affiliate_agent and lottery. No production migration or historical shared-data reassignment is implied.
legacy_mappings.p03c.outbox_delivery: P-09K: delivery_state and consumer_inbox reference ledger_outbox through (tenant_id, product_id, event_id); claim/update/expiry paths preserve product_id; no tenant-only event FK remains.
legacy_mappings.p03d.provider_inbox: P-09K: provider_event_inbox, conflicts and expectations accept canonical product IDs only; provider inbox journal FK is tenant+product+journal; identical account UUIDs are intentionally reused across Affiliate and Lottery and resolved only within product scope.
legacy_mappings.p04.schema_evolution: P-09L: migration-lab index recovery pins one client and uses nonblocking pg_try_advisory_lock; competing callers return busy immediately (no waiting snapshot); lock holder inspects indisvalid/indisready and exact pg_get_indexdef, drops invalid indexes, runs CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY outside a transaction, verifies the result and unlocks; valid definition drift fails closed. Concurrent test requires one repair plus busy or valid. Synthetic only.

migration_rules: Never collapse shared and platform into a product identifier.
Never infer product identity from payload fields or caller-controlled event data.
Never use a bare UUID as a globally unique event, effect, journal, or correlation key.
Financial effects and journals must always belong to exactly one product scope.
Platform-scoped events cannot create financial effects or journals.
Legacy rows without an unambiguous product/scope mapping must be quarantined for reconciliation, not guessed.
Never automatically reinterpret legacy shared rows; inventory and quarantine them until an authoritative tenant/product mapping is approved.
P-05B replay inbox, economic-effect uniqueness and aggregate cursor identity must include canonical product scope.

Concurrent index recovery must pin one session, use nonblocking pg_try_advisory_lock (never wait with an open query snapshot), run CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY outside a transaction, verify exact catalog definition, and destroy a pooled connection if unlock state is uncertain.
